aliases: ancient desolate plant immemorial desolate plant

summary.text: Desolate plants are fierce plants ranked alongside desolate beasts as immortal resources. Ancient and immemorial desolate plants carry higher battle strength and denser dao marks.

claims.text: Shi Lei calls the walking meat tree a legendary ancient desolate plant after its tentacle-like branches thrash Gu Immortals in Star Form blessed land’s eighth star hall. Hits from that tree etch strength path dao marks into the target’s body and strike the internal organs hard.

Hei Lou Lan judges the walking meat tree’s aura as rank seven battle strength at least, and names it a rare strength path plant. Fang Yuan links it to black heaven life forms that a rank eight Gu Immortal such as Seven Star Child could have brought back from exploration.
Hei Lou Lan later regrets missing that ancient desolate plant, saying it can sell for a higher price than the astral wind flying heavenly boar.

In a Starry Sky grotto-heaven fragment world, Combat Immortal Sect leaves a desolate plant nether grass rooted in place beside desolate beasts. A stalk of nether grass is useful to a soul path Gu Immortal. Because it holds large numbers of soul path dao marks, over time it turns a wide surrounding range into a breeding ground for soul path Gu worms and can modify a blessed land or grotto-heaven environment.

Some wild Immortal Gu live in desolate beasts and desolate plants, absorbing nutrients and coexisting while treating them as food. A savage rank seven Dragon Centipede instead captures desolate beasts and desolate plants as prey; that Gu hunts ancient desolate beasts and desolate plants to fill its stomach.

The thousand snakes haze tree is an immemorial desolate plant. Even damaged, it can kill ancient desolate beasts and desolate beast groups. Intact, it has incredible battle strength rivaling rank eight Gu Immortals; even the weakest rank eight being is beyond Fang Yuan’s then rank six strength.

Around heavenly dew oasis, acupuncture trees show the plant tiers in one place: ordinary trees are most numerous, desolate plant acupuncture trees are larger still, and ancient desolate plant acupuncture trees are mountain-sized. At ancient desolate level those trees blossom each year and scatter seed petals.
White python grass is named an immemorial desolate plant when offered as a birthday gift, with dragon essence and the shape of a white python bearing scales and dragon horns.
The thousand wish tree is a human path ancient desolate plant that uses human will to create fruits, and grows best where human will is dense, such as a large city or market.
Beast-side tiers on the same scale are covered on desolate beast.
